query_instruction:
Instruct: Retrieve the medical evidence passage that directly supports this renal education query.

first_stage_scoring.formula: score(p) = dot(q, p) + 0.18 * dot(q, doc(p)) + 0.12 * dot(q, sec_struct(p))

candidate_selection.superset_budget_B_note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Measured analytically; not an active intelligent 50-to-20 selection stage in production. Production retrieval uses candidate_depth=20 (direct top-20 from first-stage scoring).
candidate_selection.reranker_input_budget_R_note: Authoritative production reranker availability metric. RerankerInputHit@20 reflects actual evidence passage availability at inference time.
candidate_selection.selection_policy_note: QwenRenalRetrieverV4 uses candidate_depth=20 directly. The evaluation additionally computed CandidateCoverage@50 for diagnostic purposes only.
